subject: Arcadia Health post-sign onboarding handoff & owner assignment
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Heather Liu <heather.liu@arcadiahealth.com>, procurement@arcadiahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-17T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Handoff: Arcadia Health onboarding — recommended owner & next steps

Team — quick handoff note for Arcadia (DEAL-2026-0921). Signed SOW attached. High-level context: Arcadia is a mid-market health-tech provider; anticipated 10k MAUs during pilot, targeting go-live (pilot) on 2026-12-15 with a phased rollout into production in Q1. Contract includes Dedicated capacity for primary inference and a private VPC link for PHI ingestion. Key contacts: Heather Liu (technical sponsor), procurement@arcadiahealth.com (billing).

Immediate asks:
- Assign primary CS steward and secondary technical owner (expected: CS lead + one engineering contact).
- Confirm readiness checklist owners for the items listed below.
- Schedule a 60-min internal kickoff (pre-kickoff with Prod Eng & Infra) this week if possible.

Known constraints / risks:
- Procurement requested a 90-day invoice net term; finance has asked for a credit hold contingency until PO is confirmed.
- Arcadia requires SOC2 evidence and a 30-day retention policy for audit logs — we will need compliance signoff before PII flows.
- Expected burst TPS for inference ~150 rps during business hours; we should validate Dedicated pool sizing (see capacity_estimate_arcadia.xlsx).

Attachments: signed_SOW_Arcadia.pdf (SOW, cleared), capacity_estimate_arcadia.xlsx (initial sizing).

Links: HubSpot deal + onboarding folder in Drive (added below).

Markus
Markus Klein | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Heather Liu <heather.liu@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Arcadia Health onboarding — recommended owner & next steps

Thanks Markus — I can take primary stewardship for post-sign onboarding.

Proposed next steps from CS side:
1) Internal kickoff (CS + Prod Eng + Infra): propose Thu 2026-11-18 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 2026-11-19 09:00-10:00 PT.
2) Customer kickoff (intro + timeline + acceptance criteria): aim for the week of 2026-11-22.
3) Create a Mutal Action Plan (MAP) doc within the Drive folder and assign owners for each line item.

Notes / dependencies for Arcadia:
- Need SSO details (SAML) and network CIDR for VPC peering before we schedule dedicated provisioning.
- CS will own MAP, acceptance criteria (50k tokens/month baseline for pilot), and cutover window coordination.

Heather — is either Thu or Fri workable for an internal pre-kickoff briefing? If you prefer, we can set the customer kickoff after we validate SSO and network items.

Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Heather Liu <heather.liu@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Arcadia Health onboarding — recommended owner & next steps

Thanks — noted. A few technical clarifications from infra/eng perspective: 
- Estimated sustained qps (50–75 rps) with 150 rps bursts during business hours. Dedicated GPU pool recommended with 2x serving nodes of p4d or equivalent for pilot to meet the 99th latency SLO. See attached capacity_estimate_arcadia.xlsx for recommendations and cost delta.
- Model selection: customer prefers open LLM (redwood-curated) but has asked about quantized variants; Prod Eng will validate perf characteristics against 2–3 prompt families during pre-kickoff.
- Data flows / compliance: any PHI ingestion must flow through the private deployment path with KMS key management — need security team input on key rotation window (ask: SOC2 evidence + KMS ownership).

I can join the internal kickoff Thu 11/18 10am PT. We should create a short technical checklist for the customer (SSO metadata, CIDR, sample payloads, retention policy signoff).

Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Arcadia Health onboarding — recommended owner & next steps

Internal note (do not forward to Arcadia until we confirm procurement cadence):
- Finance flagged the 90-day net term. If procurement can't provide a PO within 14 days of SOW, we should toggle the credit hold process. Markus — can you confirm if Arcadia has an existing vendor relationship that would speed PO issuance?
- Suggesting a canary rollout for inference traffic: pilot to 10% of traffic for 7 days with close monitoring of token costs and latencies, then 50% for 14 days, then 100% pending signoff. Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency < 350ms and error rate < 0.5% for two consecutive weeks.
- I'll create the MAP in Drive and add line owners; will also attach the DocuSign envelope link in the shared folder.

Priyom Das
Channel/Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

- Primary CS steward: Vanessa Ortiz (owner of MAP and customer kickoff).
- Technical lead: Dylan Brooks (performance validation, Dedicated sizing).
- Finance/ops lead: Priyom Das (procurement/PO cadence and billing).

Vanessa — please send calendar invites for the internal kickoff (Thu 11/18 10:00 PT confirmed) and customer kickoff draft for week of 11/22.
Dylan — please prioritize running the two perf checks against the redwood-curated models and drop findings in the Drive folder by EOD 11/20.
Priyom — please add procurement updates to the MAP and flag any PO delays immediately so we can decide on credit hold.

Heather — thanks for your partnership — we'll be in touch with a short technical questionnaire to gather SSO and network details. Expect the internal kickoff invite shortly.

Markus
